column1: # Ash Jenna glimpsed in the Lamakan Desert after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3:
Look at the sand, Isaac.
It's still warm where they
fell.{page_break}You failed to stop it.
I only watched.{end_wait}
Jenna, wait! Whatever this\nis, we can still stop it.\nCome back!{end_wait}
Stop it? Sweet Isaac, I've\nseen what stopping it looks\nlike. It's a long grave.{end_wait}
Keep chasing them. I'll be\nwarm when the last one\nburns.{end_wait}
